thread:
alex: heads-up — customer X reported a 3x token bill spike after we rolled the new routing policy yesterday. looks like retries + tool calls are being summed twice.

maria: ugh. which part doubled? prompt or completion tokens?

alex: primarily completion-side. flow is: user -> our api -> model -> toolcall (internal retriever) -> model. when retriever errors we retry, but telemetry shows both toolcall attempt tokens and final attempt tokens added to the same request bill.

sachin: do we currently increment quota on request receive or on final response? I thought we reserved on accept.

lena: we reserve a small estimate at accept (for burst control) but actual accounting happens when completion stream finishes. retries were being recorded at both attempt close and final close because of our retry-wrapper calling recordTokenUsage() on both paths.

dan: repro log snippet:

```
X-Req-ID: r-7f3a
attempt=1 toolcall.tokens=180 completion.tokens=320 recorded=true
attempt=2 toolcall.tokens=175 completion.tokens=330 recorded=true
final merge.tokens=650 recorded=true
```

alex: see that final merge.tokens looks like sum of attempts instead of just final. so customers saw 180+320 + 175+330 = 1005 instead of final 650.

maria: is the merge step intended to dedupe attempts? I thought we were supposed to only record the successful attempt's tokens and add the model response.

sachin: yup. bug is in the stream-aggregator: it treats each attempt's toolcall as an independent span and the accounting layer listens to span_close events without checking idempotency key.

lena: actionable options:
- short-term: dedupe in billing post-process by req-id + attempt-id heuristics (fast rollback)
- medium: add idempotency token propagation & only record tokens for attempt marked final
- long-term: change quota model to "reserve on accept, finalize on success, release difference on failure" with console UX to show reserved vs charged tokens

dan: for immediate mitigation we should rollback the telemetry consumer change that started emitting attempt spans to billing. patch ready?

alex: @dan can you drop the consumer or add a guard to ignore spans with is_retry=true? If we do that, we need to surface a metric so SRE can monitor missed attributions.

dan: can do. I'll add "billing.ignore_retry_spans=true" flag and roll it out to canary. will also emit a gauge: billing.retry_spans_ignored{env=canary}

maria: console UX idea: show per-request token waterfall: prompt | model-first-attempt | toolcalls(attempts) | final-completion. that would help customers see when retries happened and why cost changed. we can wire a small drilldown from route-level billing.

sachin: agree. also need to clarify toolcall semantics in docs: are toolcall tokens charged to the same key/org? some customers run retrievers on separate infra and expect different accounting.

lena: policy decision: tool calls invoked by the model runtime should be billed to the caller's key by default. we can offer a flag to offload billing to partner keys but that's separate feature.

alex: logging parity check: make sure the token numbers reported to billing match the ones in ingestion telemetry (tokenizer + kvcache deltas). we had a mismatch because aggregator used byte-length -> token estimate, not tokenizer output.

dan: good catch. I'll patch consumer to carry tokenizer_count instead of estimate. backcompat note: older records will remain estimates for historical billing reconciliation.

maria: for quota/rate limiting behavior — we should not let retries circumvent burst windows. suggested: reserve per-request budget at arrival (small cushion) and maintain per-key in-flight counter. retries consume from same cushion, extra attempts should be accounted against reserved pool or trigger retry-throttling.

sachin: implementational detail: attach reservation_id to request metadata. when retry occurs, reuse reservation_id so meter sees it as same logical attempt rather than new.

lena: security/compliance: ensure reservation_id is internal only; don't surface it in console or logs customer can access.

alex: next steps:
- dan: roll patch to ignore retry spans in billing consumer (canary) — ETA 2h
- dan: add tokenizer_count field propagation — ETA EOD
- maria: prototype waterfall UI mock and attach to route billing page — ETA 2d
- lena: spec idempotency/reservation flow for platform review — ETA next sprint
- sachin: write reconciliation script to refund obvious double-charges in last 24h — ETA EOD

quota-bot: Notice: billing consumer feature flag billing.ignore_retry_spans set to true in canary at 2009998900 by dan.

maria: thanks all. let's sync tomorrow 10am if the canary looks good. :thumbsup:

alex: linking incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-827 — drop notes there.

sachin: I'll start the refund run after dan confirms consumer changes. trying to minimize customer noise.

lena: minor follow-up: we should add an automated alert when recorded_tokens / tokenizer_count > 1.05 to catch future regressions.

dan: ack. will add alert and telemetry dashboard tile in the canary stack.

alex: great. closing for now. thanks everyone.
